claim_boundary: This is a runtime estimate and ordering artifact, not a completed Figure 21 scan.

method.decile_sampling: split sector ids into 10 consecutive bins and time the highest estimated-topology-cost sampled sector per bin
method.estimate_is_conservative: uses hard decile samples, not random average sectors
method.rank5_vacuum_aware_timing: rank-5 paid-batch rows additionally time projector-rank-1 sectors and record a separate vacuum-aware estimate
method.ranking: already-complete first, then runnable small-to-large full sector count, failed cross-check rows last

non_claims: Does not claim unmeasured sectors are complete.
Does not resolve rows with failed modular-vs-pointed checks.
Does not compare Figure 21 to the standard side by an H2 coordinate map.
Does not make an exoticness claim.

vacuum_aware_estimate.vacuum_fraction_assumption: pointed fixed-label sectors are weighted by one universal-group constraint, so projector-rank-1 sectors are estimated at 1/|G|
